title: Se'l pensier che mi strugge (S. Festa)
desc: Sebastiano Festa, Se'l pensier che mi strugge. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
